name: nnU-Net Satellite Segmentation
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'NVML=$(find /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu-host -name "libnvidia-ml.so.*" 2>/dev/null | head -1); CUDA=$(find /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu-host -name "libcuda.so.*[0-9]" 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$NVML" ] && [ -n "$CUDA" ]; then ln -sf "$NVML" /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libnvidia-ml.so.1 && ln -sf "$CUDA" /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.1 && ldconfig && echo "[postCreateCommand] GPU NVIDIA rilevata: driver linkati."; else echo "[postCreateCommand] Nessuna GPU NVIDIA rilevata: si procede in modalita CPU-only."; fi'
